projects.title: Plenary Minutes (Part 1)
projects.description: The first part of a comprehensive analysis of all plenary minutes since 1949

projects.title: Uberblogr Ring
projects.description: A short and concise analysis of the link quality of the webring `Uberblogr`.

projects.title: Ban Party
projects.description: AI-based analysis of the election manifestos of the eight largest German parties to test the claim of a „ban party“. Uses several AI models.

projects.title: Google Maps Reviews – A Closer Look at Deletion Practices
projects.description: Analysis of over 38,000 Google Maps reviews from 12 Burgermeister branches: 304 deleted reviews over a seven-month period show that even justified criticism is deleted as “collateral damage“.

projects.title: Where Is the Aldi Border?
projects.description: Analysis of around 70,000 Google Maps supermarket locations in Germany: the Aldi Nord/Süd border runs through the Ruhr area and then almost horizontally east past Frankfurt; Lidl receives the best ratings on average (4.24 stars).

projects.title: Fair Parken? – A Privacy and Review Analysis
projects.description: Investigation of the parking service provider Fair Parken GmbH: dark patterns in the cookie banner, undisclosed tracking technologies, and a striking rating pattern (15,000+ Google reviews with 4.2 stars vs. 2.2 stars on Trustpilot).

projects.title: A Fine Line: Scam and Entrepreneurship
projects.description: Critical analysis of aggressive mobile game marketing using the example of „Dozer Demolish“: dark patterns, questionable advertising aimed at minors, and a lack of transparency about in-app purchases despite a 0-4 age rating.

projects.title: Augenblicke – Statistical Analysis of the BVG Flirting Portal
projects.description: Analysis of 20,108 entries from 240 BVG lines (2006–2021): peak activity in May 2018, U- and S-Bahn lines produce the most entries, and the word „leider“ (“unfortunately”) appears over 6,000 times.

projects.title: The Ticket Price System of Deutsche Bahn
projects.description: Reverse engineering of the undocumented DB price API based on 90 days of price data: prices vary strongly depending on when a ticket is booked, and Sparpreis fares seem almost random – the result is the alternative price search “nickets.de“.

projects.title: Fefe's Blog – An Analysis
projects.description: Evaluation of 43,908 blog entries (2005–2019) using Python and Tableau: Der Spiegel is the most linked source, the most active time is Wednesdays around 5 p.m., plus Fefe's notoriously long compound words.
